title: Align client with batch, cache, error, and view-storage specs from PR #380
body:
PR #380 introduced new API contracts for batch operations, metadata caching, error standardization, and view storage. The client still used legacy endpoints and patterns.

## Batch Operations

- Added `batch(object, BatchUpdateRequest)` method supporting create/update/upsert/delete with atomic transactions
- Migrated `createMany` to `/createMany` endpoint (was conflicting with `/batch`)
- Updated `updateMany`/`deleteMany` to use `UpdateManyRequest`/`DeleteManyRequest` schemas

```typescript
await client.data.batch('contacts', {
  operation: 'update',
  records: [
    { id: '1', data: { status: 'active' } },
    { id: '2', data: { status: 'active' } }
  ],
  options: { atomic: true, returnRecords: true }
});
```

## Metadata Caching

- Added `meta.getCached(name, options)` with ETag-based conditional requests
- Handles 304 Not Modified responses
- Parses both strong (`"abc"`) and weak (`W/"abc"`) ETags correctly

```typescript
const result = await client.meta.getCached('account', {
  ifNoneMatch: '"686897696a7c876b7e"'
});
if (result.notModified) { /* use cache */ }
```

## Error Handling

- Enhanced errors with `code`, `category`, `httpStatus`, `retryable`, `details` properties
- Enables programmatic error handling based on machine-readable error codes

## View Storage

- Added `views.create/get/list/update/delete/share/setDefault` methods
- Supports saving custom UI configurations (filters, columns, layouts)

```typescript
await client.views.create({
  name: 'active_contacts',
  object: 'contact',
  type: 'list',
  visibility: 'public',
  query: { where: { status: 'active' } },
  layout: { columns: [...] }
});
```

## Type Exports

Re-exported API types (`BatchUpdateRequest`, `MetadataCacheResponse`, `StandardErrorCode`, etc.) from `@objectstack/spec/api` for convenience.
